meta.title: Easy Math Lang — write math documents in plain text
meta.description: Easy Math Lang turns a plain text file into a clean PDF with fractions, Greek symbols and geometry drawings. Free, open source, with a desktop editor.

nav.theme: Switch between light and dark mode

hero.title: Write math in plain text.
hero.subtitle: Easy Math Lang turns a simple text file into a clean PDF with real fractions, the full Greek alphabet and geometry drawings — no design skills needed.
hero.note: Made for teachers and students. Free and open source (MIT).

showcase.title: Code → result
showcase.subtitle: The four ready-to-run samples from the editor's own Examples menu, compiled by the project compiler. Nothing on this page is drawn by hand.

basic-math.title: Basic math
basic-math.caption: Variables and calc() do the arithmetic for you.

fraction-equation.title: Fraction and equation
fraction-equation.caption: *frac() typesets fractions, and the equation is written like text.

vector.title: Vector
vector.caption: *vec() and *root() build the vector and its length.

simple-draw.title: Simple *draw
simple-draw.caption: The *draw block draws a triangle with the constraint solver.

editor.title: The editor
editor.subtitle: Screenshots of the real Easy Math Editor, rendered from the application itself.

captions.welcome: The welcome banner shown on first start
captions.gallery: The *draw gallery: every geometry command with a thumbnail

features.title: What you get
features.subtitle: Everything below ships with the app today.

symbol_bar.title: Symbol bar
symbol_bar.desc: The full Greek alphabet, arrows, relations and set/logic symbols — click to insert at the cursor.

draw_gallery.title: *draw gallery
draw_gallery.desc: 28 geometry commands, each with a thumbnail, its syntax and a one-line description.

lsp.title: Language server
lsp.desc: Error checking with a plain-language explanation for every message, plus autocompletion and hover information.

language.title: English and Vietnamese
language.desc: Switch the interface with View → Language…. Vietnamese input methods (Telex via fcitx5) are supported on Linux.

auto_close.title: Auto-close brackets
auto_close.desc: Typing ( [ { or " inserts the matching closing character, and Backspace removes an empty pair.

export.title: Export
export.desc: File → Export As… writes PDF, PNG, SVG, HTML or the Typst source.

preview.title: Live preview
preview.desc: View → Live Preview recompiles as you type and shows the result next to your code.

command_palette.title: Command palette
command_palette.desc: Ctrl+Shift+P runs any command by name; Ctrl+Shift+G opens the geometry gallery.

download.title: Download
download.subtitle: Installers for every platform are published on the releases page. The link below always points at the latest release.
download.hint: Your system looks like {os}. Pick the matching installer.
download.hint_unknown: Pick the installer for your system.
download.macos_note: macOS 14+ on Apple Silicon (M1) or newer.
download.arch: Arch Linux users: the repository also ships a PKGBUILD.
download.source: Or run it from source — see the installation guide.

docs.title: Documentation
docs.subtitle: The guides live in the repository as plain Markdown.
